scripts.build:wasm-node: cd ../crates/wasm-client && cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir ../../web/src/wasm-node target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/autonomi_wasm_client.wasm && echo '{"type":"commonjs"}' > ../../web/src/wasm-node/package.json
scripts.build:wasm: cd ../crates/wasm-client && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir ../../web/src/wasm target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/autonomi_wasm_client.wasm
